verdict.rationale: The pricing page publishes transparent rates: browsers at $0.02/hour, $5/GB for residential proxy, and agents billed at model cost +20% plus browser time and traffic. It is pay-as-you-go with non-expiring credits and free signup credits. The docs also set out documented concurrency tiers: 10 concurrent browsers at $0, 50 after a $100 top-up, and 250/500/1,000 at $1k/$5k/$25k total paid. Missing for 10: documented API request rate limits beyond concurrency, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the pricing.
